title: Review a change to a release
statement: As a product manager, I can read a pull request's changes to releases as readable records, so preparing a release gets the same scrutiny as any other change.
overview: Changes under a `.saga` path are already classified as Saga-only, so this should need no new policy.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A pull request's diff shows each changed note or step as a small file a person can read without the tool.
`query layers` lists changed releases, notes and steps as changed records.
A pull request that only changes release records is classified as a Saga-only change and is not asked for a review deck.
